name: LoveMail
source:
"I love you."
These simple words came suddenly to my email.
No return address. No clues. Just a message.
Could it have been a mistake?
Was there another meaning?

At the time I didn't think deeply on it...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE073539.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我爱你。”

这几个简单的字突然出现在我的电子邮件中。

没有回信地址，没有线索，只有讯息。

会是寄错了吗？

还是另有含义？

当时，我没有深入思考……
